title: Lens check: a Story's card must have an image, not placeholder art
description: Dropping the 'image:' front-matter key silently turns a story's home-page card into placeholder art with no editorial warning (Anthus news desk editing, 2026-11-09, privacy story v17). Add an audience-lens check in src/papyrus_content/audience_lenses.py, next to P10/C6, that a published Story's card has an image: ERROR when the card would draw placeholder art. Gherkin: 'A story whose card would draw placeholder art fails the lens check'; 'A story with a cover image passes'.
